== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Silent Servants are a cult dedicated to the [[Silent King]], a [[Dreadgod]]. Members of this group are characterized by their use of white cloths to cover the lower halves of their faces and the presence of white halos or rings around their heads. These halos serve as a [[Goldsign]], often appearing as miniature replicas of the [[Silent King]]'s own halo. The cult is known for its expertise in stealth, spying, and the potential for brainwashing or infiltrating enemy factions. They have been described as liars by some, and their [[madra]] can evoke strong, unsettling memories in others. The organization operates from a floating island featuring a prominent white tree, which is associated with their [[Goldsign]]. They have also been known to settle on the ground near ruins, such as those of [[Mount Venture]], where they replant their sacred tree. The cult includes various specialized roles, such as [[Heralds]] and [[Sages]], and they have been involved in protecting specific sects. While some view them as guardians, others regard them with suspicion due to their reputation for deception and mental manipulation. The [[Silent King]] coordinates his subjects through a form of mental unity, allowing them to exert greater power collectively, though this process can be mentally taxing for those involved.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Silent Servants are one of the various groups positioned around the valley. This faction possesses a floating island that is dominated by a massive, pure-white tree. During the recent competition, no member of the Silent Servants managed to reach the top eight, though [[Kenvata Nasuma Juvari|Juvari]] is a known member of the order. During the events, an archer from their ranks successfully discharged an arrow made of light.}}
